title: ci: the hourly schedule reruns the full battery on an already-tested SHA, the coverage lane runs on every push, and two steps make unrelated PRs red
body:
## 维护者速读

近 7 天 CI 跑了 1,309 次，折算约 **204,000 runner 分钟/周**。其中每小时定时全量约 49,000（24 %），且没有「该 SHA 已有绿色全量就跳过」的步骤；覆盖率车道（8 腿 × 22 分钟）跑在每次 push，约 64,000（31 %），只为执行 40/33/30/40 的阈值。另有两处与改动无关的红：锁文件「阴性对照」测试在 PR 分片里打活的 `origin/main`；`Install dependencies` 无重试。四项都是单步改动，workflow 是受管面。

## Measured (GitHub Actions API, window 2026-10-17 to 10-24)

- CI runs: 1,309 in 7 days (first 1,000: pull_request 369, merge_group 251, push 236, schedule 144). PR / merge_group run = 129.7 job-minutes median (16 shards at 8.8 min median plus Type Check 7.1, Build Docs 3.0, Build & E2E 2.5, dist pins 1.9). push / schedule full battery = 333 to 350 job-minutes (8 coverage shards at 22.4 min median, 16 test shards, Type Check 15).
- Schedule: `ci.yml` has `cron: '26 * * * *'`; no step compares `github.sha` with the last successful push run (grep for `schedule|unchanged|skip` in the first 135 lines finds only the rationale comment); 4 sampled schedule runs executed all 31 jobs. The same week push already produced 236 full-battery runs.
- Coverage: job `test-coverage` (8 shards, `timeout-minutes: 40`) is gated by `github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'schedule'`; thresholds in `vitest.config.mts` are lines 40 / functions 33 / branches 30 / statements 40. objectui#12256 and objectui#13210 were timeouts in this lane.
- Red source 1: `scripts/__tests__/check-lockfile-integrity.test.ts`, the describe "green on main — the negative control", spawns the real gate with `--base-ref origin/main`; run 40065885479's `Test (shard 11/16)` failed with "Lockfile integrity: @vitejs/plugin-react, next, vite" on a PR that did not touch the lockfile, making the required `Test` context red.
- Red source 2: run 40065631506 had 20 jobs fail at the step `Install dependencies` at once (1 of 25 sampled PR CI runs, about 130 job-minutes); `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` is single-attempt in every workflow.
- "Affected mode" saves little: PR shard medians 8.15 to 11.03 min versus full-battery shards 8.9 to 10.6 min. Selected-file counts are 未实测 (job logs redirect to blob storage, 403 through the proxy); `node scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs --explain` on recent bases settles it.

## Recommendation

- [ ] Schedule: first step reads the last successful push full run's `head_sha` from the Actions API and sets `should_run=false` for every job when it equals `github.sha` (fail-open on API error); or drop the cron to every 6 hours. Saves about 45,000 to 49,000 job-minutes a week.
- [ ] Coverage lane only on schedule (or nightly plus `workflow_dispatch`), thresholds unchanged. Saves about 55,000 to 60,000 a week; removes the objectstack-ai/objectui#12256 / objectstack-ai/objectui#13210 red source from the per-merge path. Accepted cost: a coverage drop under threshold surfaces hours after merge.
- [ ] Lockfile negative control asserts the gate's polarity on a fixture (as `check-required-check-set.mjs --fixture` does), never the live base ref; audit the other tests that `git grep` the tree for the same shape.
- [ ] One retry around the install in `scripts/ci-setup-pnpm.sh` (every workflow already calls it), keeping `--frozen-lockfile`.

Not proposed: a new gate. Also measured and already filed elsewhere: shard timings 12 days stale with 830 of 5,773 files unmeasured and real leg spread 1.73x (objectui#13349, PR objectui#13028).

Refs: objectui#12214, objectui#12352, objectui#12256, objectui#13210, objectui#13349, objectui#13064, objectui#13077.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24; the maintainer approved filing (「同意，创建任务」). Full evidence files sit in that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.
